'Instant - Discard this: Mark target opposing hero.'

The discard is a COST, so it is paid before the ability resolves and the card leaves the hand whether or not the mark lands. MARK targets the opponent by default (CR 9.3: marking always lands on an opposing hero), which is why the nine cards saying 'mark target opposing hero' need no target.

Mark is in the card DB `keywords` because the printed text names it, but it is this ability's EFFECT and happens only when the ability is activated -- nothing grants it unconditionally.
